description: Leave a Proton Drive folder shared with you; the owner and other members are unaffected. For your own folders use drive_share_revoke. The server asks the user to approve this itself.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

path.description: Absolute remote Drive path of the shared folder to leave (must start with '/'). E.g. /shared-with-me/project

name: drive_share_leave
title: Leave shared item
